svg.title: Where it lives: one place for everything
svg.desc: Your researcher's folder, every part with a purpose, and who writes it. Read first in every conversation: RESEARCHER.md, who you are, its voice and your rules, written by both of you; and Philosophy/, how you work and how you invest, in your own words. You write Sources/, what you give it: papers, books, clippings. Your researcher writes Knowledge/, its notes, each citing its source; Studies/, decisions weighed for and against; and Lessons/, lessons and their quizzes. The flow: Sources/, read, Knowledge/, then query, study and teach, into Studies/ and Lessons/, and you decide. It is all Markdown, plain text any assistant or editor reads, and git keeps every change.
